fields.name: Text_Welcome_Screen
fields.fieldText:
Welcome to the Quality Check


🔎 In this flow, you will capture the results of the selected Quality Check.


🛠️ You will be guided step by step through the inspection process and can document the checked machines, individual findings, ratings, and comments.


✅ Please make sure that all required information is complete and accurate before finishing the check.


📄 Once completed, the Quality Check will be updated and marked as completed.


Click Next to start the Quality Check.
